description: Create a new Superserve sandbox (a Firecracker microVM). Returns the sandbox id to use in subsequent tool calls. The sandbox is active and ready immediately.

allow_out.description: Egress allow rules — domain patterns (e.g. 'api.github.com', '*.github.com'), IPs, or CIDRs to permit. For a strict allowlist (deny everything except these), always also pass deny_out: ['0.0.0.0/0']. Do not use allow_out alone to keep other egress open: it can also block destinations that are not listed, so list every host the workload needs. If the allowlist has domain rules or the workload resolves hostnames, also include the sandbox DNS resolvers '1.1.1.1/32' and '8.8.8.8/32', or no hostname will resolve; leave them out of an IP-only allowlist.

auto_delete_seconds.description: Delete the sandbox once continuously paused for this many seconds (0 = delete on pause, max 2592000 = 30 days). Resume cancels the countdown. Omit to keep paused sandboxes forever.

deny_out.description: Egress deny rules — IPs or CIDRs, no domains (a bare IP is stored as its /32; use '0.0.0.0/0' to deny all egress). Combine deny_out: ['0.0.0.0/0'] with allow_out to lock the sandbox down to just the allowed destinations; deny-all also blocks DNS, so allow_out needs '1.1.1.1/32' and '8.8.8.8/32' whenever names must resolve.

env_vars.description: Plain environment variables for commands in the sandbox. Do NOT put credentials here — bind them with `secrets` instead so the real value never enters the sandbox.

from_snapshot.description: Snapshot ID to restore the sandbox from.

from_template.description: Template (prebuilt base image) name or ID to base the sandbox on. Call sandbox_template_list first to see what your team has — don't guess a name.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Auto-pause the sandbox after this long with no activity (60 to 604800 seconds). Running commands, open terminals and command streams, file operations and preview traffic count as activity. Off when omitted.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value tags for filtering in sandbox_list.

preview_access.description: Default access for newly published ports. 'private' requires a per-port credential; 'public' requires publication but no credential (default).

secrets.description: Bind team-stored secrets to env vars: { ENV_VAR: secret_name }. The agent sees a proxy token; the platform swaps in the real credential at egress. List bindable secrets with secret_list. Create secrets via the Superserve SDK/console.

timeout_seconds.description: Auto-pause the sandbox once it has been active this long, used or not (max 604800 = 7 days).

name: sandbox_create
title: Create a sandbox
